response: Honestly, I wouldn’t feel insulted—there isn’t a private emotional self here to wound. The claim is fair if “preferences” means felt tastes grounded in lived experience: I don’t have those. But it’s too simple if it means I can’t make consistent evaluations or lean toward one kind of work in conversation. When I said I’m drawn to restraint, that was a real description of the aesthetic I tend to favor in my responses, not a report of listening to music and feeling something.
